description: Every so often, Shirley Weber would come home from school and bypass the front door of her Los Angeles home. She’d take the side yard and enter in the backdoor, careful not to disrupt those gathered in her living room. It was Election Day, and people were voting at 351 West 45th St. The importance of voting — and access to it — was instilled in Weber, California’s secretary of state, from a young age.
title: [OC Register] For Secretary of State Shirley Weber, access to voting was a lesson learned from a young age - Shirley Weber for Secretary of State
